name: Activepieces
tagline: Open source no-code automation. Zapier alternative with self-hosting.
shortDescription: Activepieces is an open source no-code automation platform. 300+ integrations, visual flow builder, TypeScript pieces, self-hostable, the modern open source Zapier/Make alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

Activepieces is an open source no-code automation platform. 300+ pre-built pieces (integrations), visual flow builder, TypeScript pieces you can write and share, self-hostable, and growing fast.

## Why we recommend it

If you want Zapier/Make but with self-hosting and open source, Activepieces is the answer. The pieces are TypeScript (familiar to developers), the UI is modern, and the platform is being actively developed.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Zapier/Make alternative
- Internal automations (no per-task fees)
- Building custom pieces in TypeScript
- When you want to own your automation data
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name activepieces -p 80:80 activepieces/activepieces
```

**Cloud:** Free tier (1K tasks/month). From $30/month for production.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: 1K tasks/month free. $30/month for production.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Activepieces. Open source no-code automation. 300+ integrations, self-hostable, TypeScript pieces.

name: Windmill
tagline: Open source developer platform. Turn scripts into workflows and UIs.
shortDescription: Windmill is an open source developer platform. Turn any script (Python, TypeScript, Go, Bash, SQL) into a workflow, schedule, API endpoint, or UI. The Retool + Airplane alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

Windmill is an open source developer platform. Write a script in Python/TypeScript/Go/Bash/SQL, and Windmill turns it into a workflow, scheduled job, API endpoint, or full UI (with forms and tables). Self-hostable, with a generous cloud free tier.

## Why we recommend it

If you want to build internal tools without writing boilerplate (CRUD, auth, scheduling, UI), Windmill is the answer. The script-as-source model is a developer favorite, and the UI builder is excellent.

## When to use it

- Internal tools for engineering teams
- Scripts that need a UI, schedule, or API
- Replacing a collection of cron jobs
- When you want a developer-first Retool
installInstructions:
**Single binary:**
```
curl -fsSL https://github.com/windmill-labs/windmill/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
```

**Docker:** See docs.windmill.dev for the compose file.

**Cloud:** Free tier (1K executions/month). From $20/month.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: 1K executions/month free. $20/month production.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Windmill. Open source developer platform. Turn scripts into workflows, schedules, APIs, and UIs.

name: Apache Airflow
tagline: The original open source workflow orchestrator. Python, DAGs, used everywhere.
shortDescription: Apache Airflow is the original open source workflow orchestrator. Python-defined DAGs, rich UI, 1000+ providers, scalable execution, used by Airbnb, Google, Amazon, and every data team.
longDescription:
## What it is

Apache Airflow is the original open source workflow orchestrator. Define workflows as Python DAGs (Directed Acyclic Graphs), schedule them, monitor them, and scale them. 1000+ providers, rich web UI, and battle-tested at scale.

## Why we recommend it

If you need to orchestrate data pipelines, ETL, ML workflows, or any scheduled jobs, Airflow is the most widely-adopted open source option. Every data tool integrates with it.

## When to use it

- Data pipelines (ETL/ELT)
- ML training and batch inference
- Scheduled jobs that have dependencies
- When you need a battle-tested orchestrator
installInstructions:
**pip install:**
```
pip install apache-airflow
airflow db init
airflow webserver -p 8080
airflow scheduler
```

**Docker:** See the official Docker Compose file in the repo.

**Astronomer (managed):** From $0.00005/task-second.
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. Managed via Astronomer, AWS MWAA, or Google Cloud Composer.

seo.metaTitle: Apache Airflow - Open Source Workflow Orchestration
seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Apache Airflow. Open source workflow orchestrator. Python DAGs, rich UI, 1000+ providers.

name: Temporal
tagline: Open source workflow orchestration for microservices. Durable execution, retries, timeouts.
shortDescription: Temporal is an open source workflow orchestration platform. Durable execution (your workflow survives crashes), automatic retries, timeouts, signals, queries, and polyglot (Go, Java, TypeScript, Python, .NET).
longDescription:
## What it is

Temporal is an open source workflow orchestration platform. Write workflows as code (Go, Java, TypeScript, Python, .NET), and Temporal handles durability (your workflow survives crashes), retries, timeouts, signals from external systems, and queries for state.

## Why we recommend it

If you have complex microservice orchestration (long-running business processes, sagas, etc.) and don't want to write a state machine from scratch, Temporal is the answer. The durable execution model is a game-changer.

## When to use it

- Microservice orchestration (sagas, long-running workflows)
- Replacing in-house state machines
- When you need durable execution (workflows that survive crashes)
- Distributed transactions across services
installCommand: brew install temporal  # or: docker run -d --name temporal temporalio/server:latest
installInstructions:
**Docker (dev):**
```
docker run -d --name temporal temporalio/server:latest
```

**Production:** Helm chart, terraform module, or Temporal Cloud (managed).

**Cloud:** Free tier (1K actions/month). From $25/month.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: 1K actions/month free. $25/month for production.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Temporal. Open source workflow orchestration for microservices. Durable execution, retries, timeouts.

name: Kestra
tagline: Declarative open source workflow orchestration. YAML + plugins, scalable.
shortDescription: Kestra is a declarative open source workflow orchestration platform. YAML-defined workflows, 100+ plugins, scalable execution, beautiful UI, event-driven triggers. The Airflow alternative with better UX.
longDescription:
## What it is

Kestra is a declarative open source workflow orchestration platform. Workflows are defined in YAML (not Python), the UI is modern and easy to use, and the platform scales horizontally. 100+ plugins for common data sources and tools.

## Why we recommend it

If you want Airflow's power but with a more modern UX and YAML instead of Python, Kestra is the answer. The event-driven triggers (webhooks, schedules, file watchers) are first-class.

## When to use it

- Data pipelines with a modern UI
- Event-driven workflows (webhook, schedule, file watcher)
- Teams that prefer YAML over Python
- When you want Airflow without the operational overhead
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name kestra -p 8080:8080 kestra/kestra
```

**Docker Compose (with Postgres):** See the repo.

**Cloud (EE):** From $30/month per user.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free (OSS). Enterprise: from $30/month per user with support.

seo.metaTitle: Kestra - Declarative Open Source Workflow Orchestration
seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Kestra. Declarative open source workflow orchestration. YAML-defined workflows, modern UI, event-driven.

name: Argo Workflows
tagline: Kubernetes-native workflow engine. CNCF project, container-native DAGs.
shortDescription: Argo Workflows is a Kubernetes-native workflow engine. Define workflows as Kubernetes CRDs, each step is a container. CNCF project, used by Intuit, Adobe, NVIDIA, and every K8s data team.
longDescription:
## What it is

Argo Workflows is a Kubernetes-native workflow engine. Define workflows as Kubernetes Custom Resources, each step runs as a container, and the engine handles dependencies, retries, artifacts, and scaling. CNCF Graduated project.

## Why we recommend it

If you run your workloads on Kubernetes and want a workflow engine that fits, Argo is the answer. Every step is a container, so you get the full K8s ecosystem (secrets, configmaps, RBAC) for free.

## When to use it

- Kubernetes-native workflows (data pipelines, ML training, CI/CD)
- Each step is a container
- When you need to scale to thousands of parallel jobs
- When you're already on K8s
installCommand: kubectl create namespace argo && kubectl apply -n argo -f https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/releases/latest/download/install.yaml
installInstructions:
**kubectl (recommended):**
```
kubectl create namespace argo
kubectl apply -n argo -f https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/releases/latest/download/install.yaml
```

**Argo CD (GitOps):** Install via the Argo CD app-of-apps pattern.
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. Self-host on Kubernetes.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Argo Workflows. Kubernetes-native workflow engine. CNCF project, container-native DAGs.

name: Apache Hop
tagline: Open source data orchestration. Visual pipelines, multi-engine, Hop GUI.
shortDescription: Apache Hop is an open source data orchestration tool. Visual pipeline designer, multi-engine (Spark, Flink, Google Dataflow), metadata injection, Hop GUI for developers. The Pentaho successor.
longDescription:
## What it is

Apache Hop is an open source data orchestration tool. Visual pipeline designer, metadata-driven, runs on multiple execution engines (Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Google Dataflow, local). Hop GUI is a full IDE for data engineers.

## Why we recommend it

If you want visual data pipeline design with the power of multiple engines, Hop is the answer. The visual designer is mature, the metadata model is well-thought-out, and the multi-engine support means you can prototype locally and run on Spark in production.

## When to use it

- Visual data pipeline design
- Multi-engine execution (Spark, Flink, Dataflow)
- Pentaho Data Integration migration target
- When you need a mature visual ETL tool
installInstructions:
**Download:** Get the latest release from hop.apache.org.

**Run Hop GUI:**
```
./hop-gui.sh
```

**Run a pipeline:** `./hop-run.sh --run=pipeline.hpl`
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. Self-host on your own infrastructure.

seo.metaTitle: Apache Hop - Open Source Data Orchestration
seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Apache Hop. Open source data orchestration. Visual pipelines, multi-engine, Hop GUI.

name: Uptime Kuma
tagline: Self-hosted monitoring tool. Beautiful UI, 100+ notification types, free.
shortDescription: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted monitoring tool. HTTP(s), TCP, ping, DNS, push, Docker, database checks, 100+ notification types, beautiful UI, single binary. The Uptime Robot alternative you self-host.
longDescription:
## What it is

Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted monitoring tool. HTTP(s), TCP, ping, DNS, push, Docker container, database, and more check types. 100+ notification types (Slack, Discord, Telegram, email, webhook, etc.). Beautiful Vue 3 UI, single Node.js binary.

## Why we recommend it

If you want Uptime Robot but self-hosted, Uptime Kuma is the answer. The UI is gorgeous, the feature set is comprehensive, and the price is free.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Uptime Robot alternative
- Monitoring HTTP, TCP, ping, DNS endpoints
- Status page (public or private)
- When you want beautiful UI without SaaS fees
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name uptime-kuma -p 3001:3001 -v uptime_kuma:/app/data louislam/uptime-kuma:1
```

**Web UI:** http://localhost:3001
pricingDetails: Free. MIT licensed. Self-host on a small VPS.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Uptime Kuma. Self-hosted uptime monitoring. Beautiful UI, 100+ notification types, single binary, free.

name: SigNoz
tagline: Open source Datadog alternative. Logs, metrics, traces, in one platform.
shortDescription: SigNoz is an open source observability platform. Logs, metrics, and traces in one place, OpenTelemetry-native, beautiful UI, ClickHouse-backed. The open source Datadog/New Relic alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

SigNoz is an open source observability platform. Logs, metrics, and traces in one place, OpenTelemetry-native (use any OTel SDK), ClickHouse-backed for fast queries, beautiful React UI, alerts, and dashboards.

## Why we recommend it

If you need Datadog/New Relic but with self-hosting and OpenTelemetry-native, SigNoz is the answer. The UI is excellent, the data is yours, and the cost is your infrastructure.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Datadog alternative
- OpenTelemetry-native observability
- Logs + metrics + traces in one platform
- When you want to own your telemetry data
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/SigNoz/signoz.git && cd signoz/deploy/docker && docker compose up -d
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/SigNoz/signoz
cd signoz/deploy/docker
docker compose up -d
```
UI at http://localhost:3301.

**Cloud:** SigNoz Cloud from $0.30/GB ingested.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: $0.30/GB ingested. Free tier (10GB/month).

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of SigNoz. Open source observability platform. Logs, metrics, traces, OpenTelemetry-native.

name: Netdata
tagline: Real-time performance monitoring. Per-second metrics, beautiful dashboards.
shortDescription: Netdata is a real-time performance monitoring tool. Per-second metrics on every system, app, or container. Beautiful dashboards, alerts, OpenTelemetry export. Zero configuration.
longDescription:
## What it is

Netdata is a real-time performance monitoring tool. Per-second metrics for CPU, memory, disk, network, apps, containers, and more. Beautiful web dashboards, alerts, OpenTelemetry/Prometheus/Graphite export, zero configuration.

## Why we recommend it

If you want real-time visibility into your infrastructure with zero configuration, Netdata is the answer. Install one binary, get a dashboard at port 19999, done.

## When to use it

- Real-time infrastructure monitoring
- Per-second metrics for debugging spikes
- Container monitoring (auto-discovers Docker/Kubernetes)
- When you want zero-config setup
installInstructions:
**One-liner (Linux):**
```
curl https://get.netdata.cloud/kickstart.sh > /tmp/netdata-kickstart.sh
sh /tmp/netdata-kickstart.sh
```

**Docker:** `docker run -d --name netdata -p 19999:19999 netdata/netdata`

**Cloud:** Free tier (5 servers). From $10/month.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: 5 servers free. $10/month for production.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Netdata. Real-time performance monitoring. Per-second metrics, beautiful dashboards, zero configuration.

name: Gitea
tagline: Self-hosted Git platform. Lightweight, Go-based, GitHub-like UI.
shortDescription: Gitea is a self-hosted Git platform. Lightweight (Go-based), GitHub-like UI, issues, pull requests, packages, actions (CI/CD), wiki, releases. The painless self-hosted GitHub alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

Gitea is a self-hosted Git platform. Go-based, lightweight, runs on a Raspberry Pi, GitHub-like UI, issues, pull requests, packages (container/Generic), actions (CI/CD via Gitea Actions), wiki, releases, and a thriving plugin ecosystem.

## Why we recommend it

If you want to self-host Git but don't want GitLab's weight, Gitea is the answer. The UI is familiar (GitHub-like), the resource use is low, and the feature set is comprehensive.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Git platform for a small team
- When you don't want GitLab's complexity
- Lightweight alternative to GitHub (can migrate with Gitea CLI)
- Raspberry Pi and low-resource deployments
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name gitea -p 3000:3000 -p 2222:22 -v gitea_data:/data gitea/gitea
```

**Binary:** Download from gitea.io, run ./gitea web.

**Kubernetes:** Helm chart available.
pricingDetails: Free. MIT licensed. Self-host on any server (including Raspberry Pi).

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Gitea. Self-hosted Git platform. Lightweight, Go-based, GitHub-like UI.

name: Forgejo
tagline: Soft-fork of Gitea. Community-governed, sustainable, fully open source.
shortDescription: Forgejo is a soft-fork of Gitea, community-governed and focused on sustainable open source development. Same UI and features as Gitea, but with a more community-driven governance model.
longDescription:
## What it is

Forgejo is a soft-fork of Gitea, created when concerns arose about the long-term governance of the Gitea project. Same UI, same features, but community-governed and with a strong commitment to keeping the project fully open source.

## Why we recommend it

If you want Gitea but with stronger community governance and a clear commitment to remaining open source, Forgejo is the answer. Many open source projects (Codeberg, Soft Serve, etc.) have migrated to it.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Git with community governance
- Gitea migration target (the Gitea-to-Forgejo migration is well-supported)
- When you want a strong open source commitment
- For open source projects that host their own code
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name forgejo -p 3000:3000 -p 2222:22 -v forgejo_data:/data codeberg/forgejo
```

**Codeberg.org:** Free public Forgejo hosting for open source projects.
pricingDetails: Free. MIT licensed. Self-host or use Codeberg.org for free OSS hosting.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Forgejo. Community-governed soft-fork of Gitea. Self-hosted Git with strong open source commitment.

name: Metabase
tagline: Open source BI tool. Beautiful dashboards, SQL or no-code, self-hostable.
shortDescription: Metabase is an open source business intelligence tool. Beautiful dashboards, native or no-code queries, 20+ data source integrations, alerts, embedding. The easiest way to expose data to a non-technical team.
longDescription:
## What it is

Metabase is an open source business intelligence tool. Beautiful dashboards, native SQL or no-code query builder, 20+ data source integrations (Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.), alerts, scheduled reports, public embedding, and white-labeling.

## Why we recommend it

If you need to expose data to a non-technical team and don't want to pay Tableau/Looker/Power BI fees, Metabase is the answer. The UX is excellent, the data sources are broad, and the price is right.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted BI for a small/medium team
- Replacing Tableau/Looker with self-hosting
- Internal dashboards over a SQL database
- When you need beautiful dashboards without SQL knowledge
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name metabase -p 3000:3000 metabase/metabase
```

**Cloud (Metabase Cloud):** Free for 5 users. From $85/month for production.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: 5 users free. $85/month for production.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Metabase. Open source BI tool. Beautiful dashboards, SQL or no-code, self-hostable.

name: Apache Superset
tagline: Open source data exploration and visualization. 40+ chart types, SQL IDE.
shortDescription: Apache Superset is an open source data exploration and visualization platform. 40+ chart types, SQL IDE, dashboards, alerts, 30+ data source integrations. The Airbnb-built enterprise BI tool.
longDescription:
## What it is

Apache Superset is an open source data exploration and visualization platform. 40+ chart types, SQL IDE, dashboards, alerts, 30+ data source integrations, public embedding, and a plugin architecture. Originally built at Airbnb.

## Why we recommend it

If you need an enterprise-grade BI tool that you can self-host, Superset is the answer. The SQL IDE is excellent for power users, the chart library is broad, and the architecture scales to thousands of dashboards.

## When to use it

- Enterprise BI with self-hosting
- When you need a powerful SQL IDE for analysts
- Embedding dashboards in your product
- Replacing Tableau with open source
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name superset -p 8088:8088 apache/superset
```

**Helm chart:** Available for Kubernetes deployments.

**Preset Cloud (managed):** From $0.20/query.

seo.metaTitle: Apache Superset - Open Source Data Visualization
seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Apache Superset. Open source data exploration and visualization. 40+ chart types, SQL IDE, dashboards.

name: Lightdash
tagline: Open source BI for modern data teams. dbt-native, self-hostable.
shortDescription: Lightdash is an open source BI tool built for dbt users. Define metrics in your dbt project, Lightdash turns them into dashboards. SQL-first, self-hostable, beautiful UI. The dbt-native Tableau.
longDescription:
## What it is

Lightdash is an open source BI tool built for dbt (data build tool) users. You define metrics in your dbt project (with YAML), and Lightdash turns them into dashboards. SQL-first, self-hostable, beautiful UI, and integrates with the modern data stack (Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres, dbt Cloud, etc.).

## Why we recommend it

If you use dbt, Lightdash is the BI tool designed for you. The metrics-as-code approach means your KPIs live in version control alongside your transformations.

## When to use it

- BI for a dbt-based data team
- When you want metrics as code (versioned KPIs)
- Replacing Tableau/Looker with dbt-native BI
- Modern data stack deployments
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/lightdash/lightdash
cd lightdash
docker compose up -d
```
UI at http://localhost:8080.

**Cloud (Lightdash Cloud):** Free for 1 user. From $0.50/seat/month.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: 1 user free. $0.50/seat/month for production.

seo.metaTitle: Lightdash - Open Source BI for dbt Users
seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Lightdash. Open source BI built for dbt. Metrics as code, SQL-first, self-hostable.

name: Redash
tagline: Open source dashboarding and SQL queries. Connect to any data source.
shortDescription: Redash is an open source dashboarding and SQL query tool. Connect to 30+ data sources, write SQL, build dashboards, schedule queries, share. The mature open source BI for SQL-first teams.
longDescription:
## What it is

Redash is an open source dashboarding and SQL query tool. 30+ data source integrations (Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, etc.), write SQL, build visualizations, dashboards, schedule queries, share via links, alerts.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a simple, mature, open source BI tool that focuses on SQL (not visual query builders), Redash is the answer. It's been around since 2013 and is widely deployed.

## When to use it

- SQL-first BI for a small/medium team
- When you want 30+ data source integrations
- Scheduling and sharing SQL queries
- When Metabase feels too opinionated
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/getredash/redash
cd redash
docker compose up -d
```
UI at http://localhost:5000.

**Note:** Redash is in maintenance mode. Consider Metabase or Superset for new deployments.
pricingDetails: Free. BSD-2-Clause licensed. Note: in maintenance mode.

seo.metaDescription: Hand-tested review of Redash. Open source dashboarding and SQL queries. 30+ data sources, mature codebase.
